$description: What is enforced vs convention for token usage.

overrides.statement: PageSpecs carry NO per-instance style/token override field. Styling is owned by section/component contracts and the template renderOptions (skin/font/heavy). The only raw colour values a PageSpec can carry are closed content enums (pill/panel/eyebrow/fill colours) and every one of them must exist in tokens/00-foundation/color.json (checked by verify_all.py: CONTENT_HEX_IN_CATALOG).

rawValueRestrictions.color: no raw values outside the catalog
rawValueRestrictions.typography: no raw values outside the catalog

rawValueRestrictions.spacing: no raw values outside the catalog
rawValueRestrictions.breakpoint: no raw values outside the catalog
rawValueRestrictions.elevation: no raw values outside the catalog
rawValueRestrictions.motion: no raw values outside the catalog

resolutionOrder: themes/light (only theme -- no dark mode exists in src)
convention: semantic token preferred over foundation in new component code
